landing.hint: Autopilot: Generate → CR → Quality gate → CUA (Test Set · Manual · Adversarial) → Evidence → Bug → PageSpeed AI verdict

scenes.title: Ship QA that can defend itself.
scenes.body: Ticket + MRs → gated suite → multi-mode CUA → evidence → human-gated bug → PageSpeed with AI verdict.

scenes.title: Normal tools leave holes.
scenes.body: Chatbots invent steps. TMS stays hand-written. CR never becomes a test. One CUA mode is not enough.

cards.p: Pretty cases. Weak grounding. No AC proof.
No Test Set batch, no adversarial, no advisory load checks.
Numbers without an AI good/bad call.

scenes.title: Closed loop — not a chatbot.
scenes.body: Author, review, prove, run three CUA modes, capture evidence, gate bugs, judge performance.

journey.title: Story + sources loaded.
journey.voice: DEMO-1414 with AC, worklogs, Figma links, and three live MRs — Primary, Region, Theme.

ticket.summary: FedEx Pickup location at checkout — US storefront only
ac: Guest + signed-in: search FedEx Pickup by ZIP on shipping step
Selected location shows name, address, distance, hours
Place Order disabled until a pickup location is chosen
Billing address required — never overwritten by pickup
Change limited to US — UK / AU keep prior shipping UI

journey.title: Suite drafting with Full coverage.
journey.voice: Ledger before the diff. Requirement cases ∥ change cases. House + UI rows. Dedupe under coverage guard.

progress.t: House / OOB: live-deploy, Escape, scope, phone

casesPreview.s: Guest ZIP search selects FedEx location
UK checkout has no Pickup from this change (F2)
Live deploy soft-nav keeps checkout usable

journey.title: Review ran while cases drafted.
journey.voice: Three MRs. Shared diffs reviewed once on Primary. Confirmed bugs → F1, F2 on the checklist.

bugs.t: Pickup search 5xx mapped to empty list + 200
Pickup mounts without US store guard
Same change on region fork (copied from Primary)

journey.note: Locale parity OK · no conflict markers · store-scope finding never auto-cleared on ports

journey.title: Independent score: 94 / 100
journey.voice: Not an average suite. Every parameter ≥ 92. Weakest still caps overall — and it passes hard.

journey.title: Load checks before any browser opens.
journey.voice: Case oracle, repeat overlap, and merge suggestions — advisory only. Tester can re-tick.

advisories.why: No page shows transfer size without inspect_elements — kept runnable after tool attach
Suite-level claim — no single page oracle
Same setup · read-only checks · 1 run instead of 2

journey.summary: 41 loaded → 38 runnable · 1 merge group · advisory, never silent deletes

plan: Fill billing · assert Place Order enabled

journey.title: Edge + abuse plan on checkout.

items.v: 14 actions · assert failed on error copy

journey.title: Defect card — awaiting review.
journey.voice: Never auto-Jira. Human picks File bug, test problem, or skip. Ties to F1 from MR review.

bug.summary: Pickup search 5xx rendered as “No locations nearby” — Place Order stays blocked
bug.covers: F1 · ERR-STATUS · Test Set #4 · Adversarial retry
repro: Observe empty list copy · no retry

journey.title: Lab metrics · AI verdict: BAD
journey.voice: Checkout mobile after Pickup assets. CLS is fine — LCP is not. AI says do not ship until fixed.

ai.headline: Mobile checkout not ship-ready for this change
bullets: LCP 3.4s — FedEx map / location tiles compete with LCP element
Performance 61 < 80 bar used for checkout templates
CLS 0.03 is GOOD — layout not the blocker
Recommend: lazy-load map after location open · re-run PSI · target LCP ≤ 2.5s

journey.compare: Desktop Performance 88 · AI GOOD — mobile-only gate
